correctness.rationale: All indices and base rings are specified. On each component N_i and T_i the coordinate ring is Z[u,v]/(u²−1,v²−1), free rank four. For i≠j the incidence equation 1+t gives exactly Z[(Z/2)^3] (rank eight), and for i=j the relations r²=s²=1,1+r+s imply 3=0 and r=s=1, yielding F3[(Z/2)^2] (four reduced F3-geometric points). Disjoint component supports guarantee no hidden intersections/embedded components. The characteristic-two completed local algebras and the characteristic-three seven-incidence count follow by base change. The two special quartic square identities and smoothness of the quadratic factors are computed explicitly. Standalone verification passed; computations corroborate rather than replace universal ring proofs.

value.rationale: A natural classical Kummer (16_6) configuration has a complete explicit integral arithmetic refinement: twelve finite flat rank-eight incidence pieces, four nonflat characteristic-three torsion components, and precisely described inseparable length-eight characteristic-two fibers. The result distinguishes horizontal specialization from newly appearing vertical incidence and explains why naive reduced point counting loses information. Exact natural incidence schemes and complete bad-reduction stratification are motivated invariants, not an arbitrary small slice; no broader model-independent theory is claimed.
